initialization_and_cleanup_obligations.description: Control Flow Guard (/guard:cf), NX (/NXCOMPAT), ASLR (/DYNAMICBASE /HIGHENTROPYVA), and CET shadow stack (/CETCOMPAT) must remain active.
Windows 11 x64 PE loader requires page-aligned section boundaries and separate W^X page permissions when /guard:cf and /CETCOMPAT are enabled.

measurements.notes: Combining /MERGE:.rdata=.text and /ALIGN:16 with /guard:cf and /CETCOMPAT is preserved behind -DNW_ENABLE_UNSAFE_SECTION_MERGE_EXPERIMENT=ON in cmake/BuildProfiles.cmake. Byte size and OS loader rejection diagnostics are null (unverified) on the current Linux host without Windows 11 clang-cl/lld-link.

diagnostics.summary: Merging read-only Control Flow Guard / exception unwind tables (.rdata) into executable code (.text) with sub-page /ALIGN:16 conflicts with Windows 11 x64 /guard:cf and /CETCOMPAT section alignment and W^X enforcement (which occurs in the OS PE loader prior to main(), not as an application ExitCode).
diagnostics.preservation_statement: Failed sub-page alignment + section merge experiment is preserved behind -DNW_ENABLE_UNSAFE_SECTION_MERGE_EXPERIMENT=ON with null unmeasured fields rather than invented byte counts; the default compact_experiment preset retains standard section alignment and full security mitigations without silently disabling /guard:cf or /CETCOMPAT.
